name: qa-engineer
description: QA engineering for report-only automated test design and test-code authoring guidance. Use for TDD strategy, unit test patterns, integration tests, contract tests, BDD, E2E test code, mobile automation, framework selection, test framework migration, and CI/CD test pipeline planning across common stacks such as Jest, Vitest, pytest, JUnit, RSpec, PHPUnit, xUnit, NUnit, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, WebdriverIO, Appium, Cucumber, and Robot Framework. Not for running tests as QA evidence — use qa-tester.
